title: AxiomStory | Manuscript Studio That Catches Plot Holes
excerpt: A manuscript studio that flags lines that disagree and builds a story bible of every character, place and rule. Pictures and voices too. Start free.
content_html:
Write the story.
We keep the world.

An AI story studio that remembers every character and place, then builds the wiki, pictures, voices and video.

Try AxiomStory free

Free to start. No card.

Continuity

Catch the mistakes in your story before readers do.

A chat tool only sees what you paste in. AxiomStory reads every chapter and shows you the lines that disagree.

Ch 2"Mara's green eyes narrowed."

Ch 9"She looked up, her brown eyes tired."

Mara's eye color changes between chapter 2 and chapter 9.

Wiki

A Wiki that keeps up

One click builds a page for every character and place. You check each page before it goes live. Change a chapter, and only that chapter is read again.

You write the story. The wiki, the faces, the voices and the scenes come from your pages.

Pictures and voices

Same character, every chapter

Most AI image tools draw a face a little differently every time. AxiomStory saves one approved look for each character and uses it in every picture and video. Tear a coat in chapter two, and the next picture shows it.

Video

Watch the scene you wrote

Pick a scene. Your characters act it out with the same faces and speak your lines in their own voices.

Sample: Phill meets Mara. 30 seconds, made in AxiomStory.

Our promises

Your book stays yours

Every word is yours

You keep only the edits you pick.

Your draft is the source

Change the book. Update the Wiki when you are ready.

Leave any time

Changed your mind? Full refund within 7 days (14 on yearly) if you used under 10% of your credits.

Questions

Before you start

Can I bring a book I already started?

Yes. Import Word, EPUB, PDF, Markdown, HTML or plain text and keep writing.

How far do the free credits go?

About 30,000 words of help. Longer books use more, since each request reads more of the book.

What if I run out of credits?

We warn you first. At zero, AI help pauses. Paid plans refill every month and can add a credit pack; Free credits don't refill. Your writing and Wiki stay open.

Who can read my manuscript?

Read exactly how we handle manuscripts, account and workspace data in our Privacy Policy.
